cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa and the puppy Max at home. Single objects shown on their own; rooms shown cosy and lived in.

words.en: What's your address?
words.scene: A postman putting a letter into a red front door's letterbox, the house number shown as a big brass 7 on the door.
more: Write your address on the letter.
Our new address is 7 Park Road.
我们的新地址是公园路 7 号。

words.en: My aunt lives in an apartment.
words.sz: 我姑姑住在一套公寓里。
words.scene: A tall friendly apartment building with many windows and small balconies with flowers, one window lit with a family waving.
more: The apartment is on the fifth floor.
他们的公寓有两间卧室。

words.en: Grandpa sleeps in his armchair.
words.sz: 爷爷在他的扶手椅上睡觉。
words.scene: One big comfortable red armchair with soft cushions and a folded blanket on one arm.
more: Max 坐在爸爸的扶手椅上。

words.en: Tom has a bath every evening.
words.scene: Tom in a bath full of bubbles playing with a yellow rubber duck, bubbles on his head.
more: The bath is full of water.

words.en: The bathroom is upstairs.
words.scene: A clean bright family bathroom with a bath, a sink with a mirror, toothbrushes in a cup and towels on a rail.
more: Wash your hands in the bathroom.
Our bathroom is blue and white.
我们的浴室是蓝白色的。

words.en: The bathtub is white.
words.scene: One old-fashioned white bathtub with curly little feet, empty and clean, a towel hanging over the side.
more: Lily fills the bathtub with water.
There's a duck in the bathtub!

words.en: It's nine o'clock. Time for bed!
words.scene: One cosy single bed with a patchwork quilt, a fluffy pillow and a teddy bear.
more: My bed is next to the window.
Max 睡在 Lily 的床上。

words.en: Lily's bedroom is small but nice.
words.sz: Lily 的卧室很小但很漂亮。
words.scene: A cheerful child's bedroom with a bed, a little desk, toys on shelves, star stickers on the wall and a window with curtains.
more: There are three bedrooms in our house.

words.en: Put the paper in the bin.
words.scene: One green kitchen bin with a lid and a foot pedal, a banana skin about to go in.
more: Max looks in the bin for food.
Max 在垃圾桶里找吃的。

words.en: It's cold. Take a blanket.
words.scene: One soft folded blanket in red and yellow checks with fringes.

words.en: The bookcase is full of books.
words.scene: One tall wooden bookcase with glass doors full of books, a clock and a plant on top.
more: Put the dictionary in the bookcase.

words.en: Put the books on the bookshelf.
more: There is a big bookshelf in the classroom.

words.en: Max has a blue bowl.
more: Lily eats her soup from a bowl.
Put the fruit in the big bowl.

words.en: The cups are in a big box.
words.sz: 杯子装在一个大箱子里。
more: The cake is in a box.
Lily opens the box of chocolates.

words.en: There's a red carpet in the living room.
words.scene: One large soft patterned carpet in red and blue on a wooden floor, a toy car on it.
more: Don't put your feet on the carpet!
Max is sleeping on the carpet.

words.en: Sit on the chair, please.
words.scene: One simple wooden kitchen chair with a round back.
more: There are four chairs in the kitchen.
This chair is too small for Dad.
这把椅子爸爸坐太小了。

words.en: The clock says seven o'clock.
words.scene: One round wall clock with a wooden frame and big clear hands showing seven o'clock.
more: There's a big clock in the hall.
Look at the clock. We're late!

words.en: Dad works on his computer.
words.scene: One desktop computer with a screen showing a colourful picture of a fish, a keyboard and a mouse on a desk.
more: The computer is in my bedroom.

words.en: Don't put your hand on the cooker. It's hot!
words.sz: 别把手放在炉灶上，很烫！
more: We have a new cooker in the kitchen.
我们厨房里有个新炉灶。
The soup is on the cooker.

words.en: The cups are in the cupboard.
words.scene: One open wooden kitchen cupboard with neat rows of cups, plates and bowls on its shelves.
more: Put your toys in the cupboard.
The cupboard is next to the sink.

words.en: Close the curtains, please.
words.scene: A window with long blue curtains with white stars being opened, morning sunshine coming in.
more: Max is sleeping behind the curtain.

words.en: Lily's books are on her desk.
words.sz: Lily 的书在她的书桌上。
more: My desk is next to the window.

words.en: We have dinner in the dining room.
words.scene: A family dining room with a big wooden table set for dinner with plates and glasses, chairs around it and a lamp above.
more: The dining room is next to the kitchen.
Our dining room has a big table.
我们的餐厅有一张大桌子。

words.en: Please close the door.
words.scene: One red front door with a brass handle and a round window, slightly open.
more: Max is waiting at the door.

words.en: Breakfast is ready. Come downstairs!
words.scene: A cosy house cut open like a doll's house, Lily walking down the stairs to the kitchen downstairs where Mum is making breakfast.

words.en: The spoons are in the drawer.
words.scene: One wooden drawer pulled open, full of colourful socks, rolled up neatly.
more: My socks are in this drawer.
我的袜子在这个抽屉里。

words.en: Let's watch a DVD tonight.
words.sz: 我们今晚看张 DVD 吧。
words.scene: One shiny DVD disc catching the light, a rainbow of colours on its surface, next to its empty case with a cartoon fish on the cover.
more: 这张 DVD 是讲动物的。
我能借你的 DVD 吗？

words.en: Put the DVD in the DVD player.
words.sz: 把光盘放进 DVD 播放机。
words.scene: One black DVD player under a television, its disc tray open with a shiny disc in it, a remote control beside it.
more: Our DVD player is very old.
我们的 DVD 播放机很旧了。

words.en: The entrance is at the front of the house.
words.scene: The entrance of a house: a path between flowers leading to a front door with a lamp and a doormat, an arch of roses over the gate.
more: Wait for me at the entrance.

words.en: We live in a flat in the city.
words.sz: 我们住在城里的一套公寓里。
words.scene: A row of windows in a city building, one flat on the second floor lit up with a family having dinner inside, flowers on the windowsill.
more: Our flat is on the second floor.
This is a very small flat.

words.en: Your clothes are on the floor!
words.scene: A shiny wooden floor with toys scattered all over it, a sock and a book, Max lying in the middle.
more: We live on the third floor.

words.en: The milk is in the fridge.
more: Put the butter in the fridge.
There is cola in the fridge.

words.en: We need new furniture for the living room.
words.scene: A room with a group of furniture: a sofa, an armchair, a table, a lamp and a bookcase, ready in a new home.

words.en: Dad's car is in the garage.
words.scene: A garage next to a house with its door open, a small blue car inside and bicycles hanging on the wall.
more: The bikes are in the garage.

words.en: Max plays in the garden.
words.scene: A pretty family garden with green grass, colourful flowers, a tree with a swing and Max running on the lawn.
more: We eat in the garden in summer.
夏天我们在花园里吃饭。

words.en: We cook with gas.
words.scene: A gas cooker ring with a ring of small blue flames, a pot of soup on it.

words.en: Close the gate, or Max will run out!
words.sz: 关上院门，不然 Max 会跑出去！
words.scene: A small white wooden garden gate in a low fence, Max looking through the gap.
more: Grandpa is waiting at the gate.

words.en: Put your shoes in the hall.
words.scene: The front hall of a house: coats on hooks, shoes in a row, a mirror and stairs going up.
more: The phone is in the hall.
We have a concert in the school hall.
我们在学校礼堂开音乐会。

words.en: It's cold. Turn on the heating.
words.scene: A warm white radiator under a window on a snowy day, Max lying in front of it enjoying the warmth, wavy heat lines rising.

words.en: Lily is at home today.
words.scene: A warm cosy house at dusk with lit windows, smoke from the chimney, Mum opening the door for Lily and Max coming home.

words.en: Lily's house has a red door.
words.sz: Lily 家的房子有一扇红门。
words.scene: One pretty two-storey house with a red door, a garden and flower boxes under the windows.
more: Come to my house after school.

words.en: I can't find my key!
words.scene: One shiny brass house key on a ring with a little toy dog keyring.
more: Mum has a key to the garage.
The key is in the door.

words.en: Mum is cooking in the kitchen.
more: The kitchen is next to the dining room.
Dad is washing the plates in the kitchen.

words.en: There's a lamp next to my bed.
words.scene: One bedside lamp with a yellow lampshade glowing warmly on a small table.

words.en: It's dark. Turn on the light, please.
more: Can you turn on the light, please?
senses: Lily has a light blue dress.

words.en: We live in a small town.
words.scene: A family standing happily in front of their house in a small town, Max at their feet, neighbours waving from the next house.
more: My grandparents live near the sea.

words.en: We watch television in the living room.
words.scene: A cosy family living room with a sofa, an armchair, a television, a carpet and a lamp, Max asleep on the sofa.
more: The living room is very big.
Grandpa is in the living room.

words.en: The cake is in the oven.
words.scene: One kitchen oven with its glass door showing a cake rising inside, warm orange light.
more: The oven is very hot. Be careful!
Mum puts the bread in the oven.

words.en: My pillow is very soft.
words.scene: One big fluffy white pillow with a small blue star pattern, a little dent in the middle.

words.en: Put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.scene: One tall white refrigerator with two doors, colourful magnets and a child's drawing on the front.
more: The refrigerator is full of food.

words.en: There's a cat on the roof.
words.scene: A red tiled house roof with a chimney, a ginger cat sitting on top of it in the sun.
more: Our house has a red roof.
The rain is on the roof.

words.en: This is my room.
words.scene: A bright empty room with white walls, a big window, a wooden floor and a single chair, sunlight on the floor.
more: How many rooms are there in your house?
Tom's room is next to mine.

words.en: Put the rubbish in the bin.
words.scene: A pile of rubbish next to an overflowing bin: an apple core, paper, a can and a banana skin, Max sniffing it.
more: Don't leave rubbish in the park.

words.en: The baby is safe in her bed.
words.scene: Lily holding Tom's hand and waiting safely at a pedestrian crossing, the green man light showing, a lollipop lady helping them.
more: Keep your money in a safe place.
Is it safe to swim here?

words.en: The books are on the shelf.
words.scene: One wooden shelf on a wall with a row of colourful books, a toy robot and a small plant.
more: Put the cups on the top shelf.
把杯子放在最上面的架子上。
The shelf is too high for Tom.

words.en: Dad has a shower every morning.
words.scene: A shower head spraying water in a tiled bathroom, a yellow shower curtain with ducks, steam rising.
more: I have a shower after football.

words.en: The plates are in the sink.
words.scene: A kitchen sink full of bubbles and dirty plates, the tap running, a yellow sponge on the side.
more: Wash your hands at the sink.
The sink is full of water.

words.en: Grandma is in the sitting room.
words.scene: Grandma's old-fashioned sitting room with a flowery sofa, a fireplace, family photos on the wall and a cup of tea on a little table.
more: We have tea in the sitting room.
The sitting room has a fire.

words.en: Max is sleeping on the sofa.
words.scene: One big comfortable blue sofa with three cushions.
more: We sit on the sofa and watch television.
我们坐在沙发上看电视。

words.en: We stay at Grandma's house in summer.
words.scene: Lily and Tom arriving with small suitcases at Grandma's house to stay, Grandma hugging them at the door.
more: Can I stay up late tonight?

words.en: Where is the toilet, please?
words.scene: One clean white toilet in a small tiled bathroom, a roll of toilet paper beside it.
more: Can I go to the toilet, please?

words.en: Dry your hands with a towel.
words.scene: One big fluffy striped towel folded on a rail.
more: Take a towel to the beach.
